feedback: Excellent retro-90s execution. All 8 pages present with correct asymmetric layouts, beveled borders, tiled background, marquee strips, visitor counter, pixel-style Devanagari headings in hot pink with cyan/black shadows, and persistent tab navigation. All 8 image assets exist and are used. Responsive collapses cleanly to 2-col tablet and 1-col mobile. Minor gaps: the spec says the tab nav should appear in the same position on every page, but it's placed at the bottom only on mukhya-prishth and at the top elsewhere — inconsistent placement. The jingle grid spec requested an asymmetric '4 columns left, 2 columns right' arrangement but the implementation uses a 4-col jingle grid plus a single sidebar column. The schedule's right-side 'top 10' sidebar is somewhat narrow at 245px, making sidebar headings wrap awkwardly. The home page's right header GIF placeholder is a bit small and lacks a more prominent retro radio set image area as described. No actual animated GIFs, but pixel art / static stands in adequately.
